title: Prove joint numerical and countdown backing during native ADD
body:
## Summary

Native ADD retains numerical arena arrays after callback scratch is erased. This source-bound storage lemma joins that backing with actual countdown lifetimes after extent preparation:

```text
joint backing <= K + N + max(C,H_C)
callback numerical high water persists into native countdown work
```

The minimal complete witness reaches 134 backing cells versus a 114-cell live-content peak. `research/selected-add-joint-backing/` contains the written proof, pinned sources, reproducible census, receipt and open next questions. Task `uniform-transfer-audit`, priority revision 5. Started from canonical main `90a72fb3739bfe4e8b8148a8f3dd7de876cfb022`; refreshed main `a7482490b4ca256db67d767a33fa6f7553060807` leaves guidance and consumed scientific inputs unchanged.

## Evidence

- **Before:** a phase-wise live maximum allows 114 cells; a real 133-cell backing quota rejects the native execution.
  **After:** the joint formula permits exactly 134 and passes. Warm arenas require 536; retaining cleared callback count tapes reaches 304 against a released-case allowance of 216.
- Registered CPython 3.12 replay passes 41 complete native ADD fixtures plus the successful capture counterexample and seven optimized behavioral tests. CPython 3.14 optimized replay/tests also pass.
- Independent integer-address output checks include all 25 basis inputs of the minimal fibre. Source hashes/blobs, borrowed bytes/ownership, aliases, erased backing, weak count observation and restoration paths are checked.
- Ruff diagnostics/formatting pass. Repository research workflow suite passes 144 tests with seven skips. Committed-byte preflight passes all 16 package/input files at `70530e39253f507f3773e48a0b9e6484c3143835`.
- Separate read-only source review identified the payload-factory hypothesis, now explicit. No human or formal-kernel review is claimed. Live overlap refreshed over 496 open PRs, 2,119 closed/merged PRs and 1,597 Discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings; arbitrary diffs and unpublished work remain outside coverage.

Reproduce with `uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-add-joint-backing`.

Credit Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml's unchanged PR2697 implementation and retained notice; Nick Petalas's PR2759/2770/2778 arithmetic and liveness work; Ross Richardson's PR2825 source export; PR2831 numerical backing; and Nick Petalas's PR2905/2912/2916 countdown/preparation/common-cut predecessors. This takes the [released numerical-backing handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18970664); the [scoped claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18971686) tracks its refinement away from already-covered callback liveness.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** research.

Adds one isolated package. The theorem assumes successful admitted execution, canonical distinct arenas, the default payload factory and callback restoration/release contracts. It does not establish extent preparation, full selected callback admission, all storage categories, total private A, physical placement/movement, recursive/outer reserve, a new supplier or a new kappa. Selected and frozen predecessor artifacts remain unchanged. Hosted CI is separate from the local evidence above.
